function.name: ask_user
function.description: Hand a step to the user (a login, a CAPTCHA, a one-time code) and wait until they continue or cancel. "input" asks for a short typed answer.

function.name: done
function.description: Finish the task and report to the user. outcome "success" only when you have seen the result of every action you took; otherwise "partial" or "failed". The summary is your final answer to the user.

summary.description: The answer for the user, in Markdown

function.name: read_attachment
function.description: Read a text file the user attached, from an offset, when its text did not fit in the message or was elided. The id is in the note after the file.

function.name: save_file
function.description: Save text you made as a file in the user's Downloads folder: CSV, Markdown, JSON, plain text or HTML. In Ask mode the user is asked first. An existing file is never overwritten.

filename.description: A plain file name ending in .csv, .md, .json, .txt or .html

content.description: The whole text of the file
